snippet.title: Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball gameplay (PC Game, 1995)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball, Dos PC game produced by Acclaim in 1995 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/frank-thomas-big-hurt-baseball/7650/
Frank Thomas Big Hurt Baseball is a very nice game of baseball, a perfect simulator. There are 6 distinct game modes, allowing for single exhibition matches as well as full seasons on the playoffs.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.
